Class DefaultChaosActivationHandle

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.DefaultChaosActivationHandle
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChaosActivationHandle, AutoCloseable
@Internal public final class DefaultChaosActivationHandle extends Object implements ChaosActivationHandle
Default implementation of ChaosActivationHandle.

Each instance corresponds to a single registered chaos scenario. It wraps a ScenarioController and provides the public lifecycle API:

  • start() — transitions the controller to ACTIVE.
  • stop() — transitions the controller to STOPPED.
  • release() — releases any held ManualGate.
  • destroy() — permanently unregisters the scenario from the registry and stops the controller. After destroy(), the scenario can no longer participate in chaos decisions.

This class is public rather than package-private so that StartupConfigPoller (in the bootstrap package) can call destroy() — an operation not exposed on the public ChaosActivationHandle API. Constructors remain package-private so only core code can instantiate handles.

Thread safety

All methods delegate to thread-safe internals. Instances may be used from multiple threads.

    • destroy

      public void destroy()
      Permanently stops the scenario and removes it from the ScenarioRegistry.

      Calling this method ensures that the scenario no longer appears in registry lookups and cannot participate in future chaos decisions. The registry removal is safe to call concurrently because ConcurrentHashMap.remove(Object) is thread-safe.

      Public rather than package-private so that StartupConfigPoller (in the bootstrap package) can fully unregister scenarios during config-diff application — calling stop() alone would leak entries into the registry indefinitely across reloads.
